G4396.definition: one who acts as an interpreter or forth-teller of the Divine will (see Lft., Notes, 83f.; Tr., Syn., §vi), a prophet; 1. in cl. (Æsch., Hdt., Plat., al.), of the interpreters of oracles. ; 2. In NT, ; (a) of the OT prophets: Mat.5:12, Mrk.6:15, Luk.4:27, Jhn.8:52, Rom.11:3, al.; (b) of prophets in general: Mat.10:41 13:57 21:46, Mrk.6:4, Luk.13:33, al.; (with) of John the Baptist: Mat.21:26, Mrk.6:15, Luk.1:76; (d)…

G4367.definition: προσ-τάσσω; 1. with accusative of person(s), to place at, to attach to. ; 2. to give a command, enjoin, appoint: Luk.5:14; with dative of person(s), Mat.1:24; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.8:4, Mrk.1:44; with accusative and inf., Act.10:48; pass., Act.10:33 17:26.†; (AS)

G4352.definition: προσ-κυνέω, -ῶ; (κυνέω, to kiss),  ; to make obeisance, do reverence to, worship; (a) prop. (as in cl., of the gods: Hdt., Æsch., Plat., al.), of God, Christ and supra-mundane beings: absol., Jhn.4:20 12:20, Act.8:27 24:11, Heb.11:21 (Westc., in l), Rev.11:1; πίπτειν καὶ π., Rev.5:14; with dative (of the significance of this constr. as com­pared with the usual cl., with accusative, see Abbott, JG, 78 f.; JV, 133…

G4374.definition: προσ-φέρω; 1. to bring to, lead to: with accusative and dative of person(s), Mat.4:24 8:16 9:2, 32 14:35 17:16, Mrk.2:4 (WH, R, txt.; sc. αὐτόν) Mrk.10:13, Luk.18:15 23:14; pass., Mat.12:22 (act., WH, txt.) Mat.18:24 (προσήχθη, WH) Mat.19:13; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.25:20; id. with dative of person(s), Mat.22:19, Luk.23:36; τ. στόματι, Jhn.19:29; metaphorically, with dative of person(s), to deal with…

G4314.definition: prep. with genitive, dative, accusative ; I. I. C. genitive, of motion from a place, from the side of, hence metaphorically, in the interests of, Act.27:34 (cf. Page, in l.). ; II. II. C. dative, of local proximity, hard by, near, at: Mrk.5:11, Luk.19:37, Jhn.18:16 20:11, 12 Rev.1:13. ; III. C. accusative, of motion or direction towards a place or object, to, towards. ; 1. Of place, ; (a) after verbs of motion or of…

G4334.definition: προσ-έρχομαι; to approach, draw near: absol., Mat.4:11, Luk.9:42, al.; with infin., Mat.24:1, al.; with dative loc., Heb.12:18, 22; dative of person(s), Mat.5:1, and freq., Jhn.12:21, al.; ptcp., προσελθών, with indic., Mat.8:2, and freq., Mrk.1:31, Luk.7:14, al.; π. αὐτῷ, with indic., Mat.4:3, Mrk.6:35, ; Metaphorical, ; (a) of approaching God: absol. (Lev.21:17, Deu.21:5, al.), Heb.10:1, 22; τ. θεῷ, Heb.7:25 11:6…

G4350.definition: προσ-κόπτω; 1. trans., to strike (e.g. hand or foot) against: with accusative before πρός, figuratively, Mat.4:6, Luk.4:11, (LXX) ; 2. Intrans., to stumble: absol. (Tob.11:9, Pro.3:23), Jhn.11:9-10; of wind, to rush against, beat upon: with dative, Mat.7:27. Metaphorical, in late writers, ; (a) to offend (Polyb.); (b) to take offence at, stumble at: before ἐν, Rom.14:21; with dative, τ. λόγῳ, 1Pe.2:8; τ. λίθῳ τ.…
renderings: so that You will not strike

G4337.definition: προσ-έχω; 1. to turn to, bring to (frequently ναῦν, expressed or understood, to bring to port, land; Hdt., al.). ; 2. τ. νοῦν, before dative, to turn one's mind to, attend to; in Xen. and later writers with νοῦν omitted (El., § 53, 1; 81, 1): Act.8:6 16:14, Heb.2:1, 2Pe.1:19; in sense of caring or providing for, Act.20:28; π. ἑαυτῷ, to give heed to oneself (M, Pr., 157; cf. Gen.24:6, Exo.10:28, al.): Luk.17:3 21:34…

G4383.definition: (πρός, ὤψ),  ; 1. prop., of persons (so always in cl.); (a) the face, countenance: Mat.6:16-17, Mrk.14:65, Luk.9:29, 2Co.3:7, Rev.4:7, al.; τὸ π. τῆς γενέτεως (EV, natural face), Jas.1:23; πίπτειν ἐπὶ (τὰ) π., Mat.17:6, Luk.5:12, Rev.7:11, al.; ἀγνοούμενος τῷ π., Gal.1:22; π., οὐ καρδίᾳ, 1Th.2:17; κατὰ πρόσωπον (in front, facing: Thuc., Xen., al.), when present, face to face, Act.25:16, 2Co.10:1 10:7, Gal.2:11; id.…

G4369.definition: προσ-τίθημι; 1. to put to. ; 2. to add, join to, give in addition: with accusative before ἐπί, Mat.6:27, Luk.3:20 12:25; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, Act.2:47; with accusative and dative, Luk.17:5, Heb.12:19 (see MM, xxi); pass., absol., Act.2:41, Gal.3:19; with dative, Mat.6:33, Mrk.4:24, Luk.12:31, Act.5:14 11:24; προσιτέθη πρὸς τ. πατέρας (cf. Gen.26:8, Jdg.2:10, al.), Act.13:36; with inf., of repeating or continuing the action…

G4395.definition: (προφήτης),  ; to be a προφήτης (which see), to prophesy: in the primary sense of telling forth the Divine counsels, Mat.7:22 26:68, Mrk.14:65, Luk.1:67 22:64, Act.19:6, 1Co.11:4-5 13:9 14:1 14:3-5 14:24 14:31 14:39, Heb.11:3; with the idea of foretelling future events (an idea merely incidental, not essential; see Lft., Notes, 83 f.), Mat.11:13, Act.2:17-18" (LXX) Act.21:9; before περί, Mat.15:7, Mrk.7:6, 1Pe.1:10…

G4363.definition: προσ-πίπτω; 1. to fall upon, strike against: with dative, of wind, Mat.7:25. ; 2. to fall down at one's feet, fall prostrate before: absol., before πρός, Mrk.7:25; with dative of person(s), Mrk.3:11 5:33, Luk.8:28, Act.16:29; τ. γόνασιν, Luk.5:8.†; (AS)

G4341.definition: προσ-καλέω, -ῶ; to call to. Mid., to call to oneself (see M, Pr., 157): with accusative of person(s), Mat.10:1, Mrk.3:13 6:7, Luk.7:19, Act.5:40, Jas.5:14, al. Metaphorical, of the Divine call: Act.2:39; with inf., Act.16:10 (see Bl., § 69, 4); before εἰς, Act.13:2.†; (AS)

G4328.definition: προσ-δοκάω, -ῶ; (the simple verb exists only in the forms δοκέω, -εύω)  ; to await, expect: Mat.24:50, Luk.3:15 12:46, Act.27:33 28:6; with accusative of person(s), Mat.11:3, Luk.1:21 7:19-20 8:40 Act.10:24; with accusative of thing(s), 2Pe.3:12-14; with accusative and inf., Act.28:6; with inf., Act.3:5.†; (AS)

G4377.definition: προσ-φωνέω, -ῶ; 1. to address, call to; in cl., with accusative of person(s), with dupl. accusative (cf. 2Mac, l.with); absol. (Hom., Od., v, 159, al.): Act.21:40 In late writers, with dative of person(s): Mat.11:16, Luk.7:32 13:12 23:20, Act.22:2. ; 2. to call by name, summon: with accusative (as in cl.), Luk.6:13.†; (AS)

G4394.definition: (προψητεύω)  ; the gift (and its exercise) of interpreting the Divine will and purpose, prophecy, prophesying: of OT prophecy, Mat.13:14, 2Pe.1:20-21; of NT prophecy, Rom.12:6, 1Co.12:10 13:2 14:6 14:22, 1Ti.4:14, Rev.11:6 22:19; pl., 1Co.13:8, 1Th.5:20, 1Ti.1:18; οἱ λόγοι τῆς π., Rev.1:3 22:7, 10 22:18; τ. πνεῦμα τῆς π., Rev.19:10 (Luc., FlJ, LXX, π.; see Deiss., BS, 235 f.; MM, xxii).†; (AS)

G4340.definition: πρόσ-καιρος, -ον; 1. in season. ; 2. for a season, temporary, transient: 2Co.4:18, Heb.11:25; of plants, short-lived: Mat.13:21, Mrk.4:17.†; (AS)

G4357.definition: προσ-μένω; 1. to wait longer, continue, remain still: Act.18:18; before ἐν, 1Ti.1:3. ; 2. C. dative, to remain with: Mat.15:32, Mrk.8:32. Metaphorical, to remain attached to, cleave unto, abide in: τ. κυρίῳ, Act.11:23 (R, txt.; ἐν τ. κ., R, mg., see supr.); τ. χάριτι τ. θεοῦ, Act.13:43; τ. δεήσεσιν, 1Ti.5:5.†; (AS)

G4355.definition: προσ-λαμβάνω; 1. to take in addition. ; 2. to take to oneself, take, receive; in NT always mid., -ομαι; ; (a) of things: of food, with accusative, Act.27:33; with genitive part., Act.27:36; (b) of persons: with accusative, Mat.16:22, Mrk.8:32 (see Swete, in l), Act.17:5 18:26 28:2, Rom.14:1, 3 15:7, Phm 17.†; (AS)

G4399.definition: προ-φθάνω; with ptcp. (as in cl., but more frequently the simple φθάνω, which see), ; to anticipate: Mat.17:25.†; (AS)

G4335.definition: προσ-ευχή, -ῆς, ἡ; (προσεύχομαι),  ; 1. prayer to God: Mat.17:21 (WH, R, txt., om.) Mat.21:22, Mrk.9:29, Luk.22:45, Act.3:1 6:4 10:31, Rom.12:12, 1Co.7:5, Col.4:2; pl., Act.2:42 10:4, Rom.1:10, Eph.1:16 Col.4:12, 1Th.1:2, Phm 4 22, 1Pe.3:7 4:7, Rev.5:8 8:3-4; οἶκος προσευχῆς, Mat.21:13, Mrk.11:17, Luk.19:46" (LXX) ; π. καὶ δέησις, Eph.6:18, Php.4:6; pl., 1Ti.2:1 5:5; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, prayer to God (ef. Wis.16:28)…

G4339.definition: (προοελαύνω),  ; 1. one who has arrived, a stranger. ; 2. Of converts to Judaism, a proselyte (see DB, see word): Mat.23:15, Act.2:10 6:5 13:43.†; (AS)

G4302.definition: προ-λέγω; 1. to tell or say before­hand: 2Co.13:2, Gal.5:21, 1Th.3:4 (R, txt.; cf. προεῖπον, but see infr.). ; 2. to declare, tell plainly: 2Co, Ga, 1Th, ll. with (R, mg.; see MM, xxi, and cf. Isa, l.with).†; (AS)

G4351.definition: προσ-κυλίω ; to roll up, roll to: with accusative and dative, Mat.27:60; accusative before ἐπί, Mrk.15:46.†; (AS)

G4342.definition: προσ-καρτερέω, -ῶ; (καρτερός, strong, stedfast)  ; to attend constantly, continue stedfastly, adhere to, wait on: with dative of person(s), Mrk.3:9, Act.8:13 10:7; with dative of thing(s), Act.1:14 2:42 6:4, Rom.12:12, Col.4:2; before ἐν, Act.2:46; εἰς, Rom.13:6.†; (AS)

G4344.definition: προσ-κεφάλαιον, -ου, τό; a pillow, cushion: Mrk.4:38.†; (AS)

G4358.definition: προσ-ορμίζω; (ὅρμος, an anchorage), ; to bring a ship to anchor at; usually in mid., to come to anchor near, and so pass. in late writers (Ael., Dio Cass.): Mrk.6:53.†; (AS)

G4370.definition: προσ-τρέχω; to run to: Mrk.9:15 10:17, Act.8:30.†; (AS)

G4347.definition: προσ-κολλάω, -ῶ,; to glue to; pass., reflexive, to stick to, cleave to (Plat.): metaphorically (with dative, Jos.23:8, Sir.6:34 al.), before πρός, Mrk.10:7 (R, txt.), Eph.5:31 (LXX).†; (AS)

G4365.definition: προσ-πορεύομαι; to come near, approach: with dative of person(s), Mrk.10:35.†; (AS)

G4319.definition: προσ-αιτέω, -ῶ; 1. to ask besides. ; 2. to continue asking; hence, to importune, beg, ask alms: Jhn.9:8.†; (AS)

G4392.definition: πρό-φασις, -εως, ἡ; (φήμι),  ; a pretence, pretext: Mat.23:1 (WM, R, txt., om.), Mrk.12:40, Luk.20:47 Jhn.15:22, Act.27:30, Php.1:18, 1Th.2:5.†; (AS)

G4305.definition: προ-μεριμνάω, -ῶ ; to be anxious beforehand: Mrk.13:11.†; (AS)

G4301.definition: προ-λαμβάνω; 1. to take beforehand: with accusative, 1Co.11:21 (but see infr.). ; 2. to be beforehand, anticipate (in cl., with accusative, genitive or dative): with inf. (= cl. φθάνω, see Bl., § 69, 4; Swete, in l), Mrk.14:8. ; 3. to overtake, surprise: pass., Gal.6:1 (on the virtual disappearance of the temporal force of the preposi­tion in this compound here and perhaps also in 1Co, l.with, see MM, xxi).†; (AS)

G4315.definition: προ-σάββατον, -ου, τό; the day before the Sabbath: Mrk.15:42 (L, Tr., txt., πρὸς σ.).†; (AS)

G4327.definition: προσ-δέχομαι; 1. to receive to oneself, receive favourably, admit, accept: with accusative of person(s), Luk.15:2, Rom.16:2, Php.2:29; with accusative of thing(s), Act.24:15 (R, mg.), Heb.10:34 11:35. ; 2. to expect, look for, wait for: with accusative of person(s), Luk.12:36; with accusative of thing(s), Mrk.15:43, Luk.2:25, 38 23:51, Act.23:21, Tit.2:13, Ju 21 (cf. δέχομαι).†; (AS)

G4313.definition: προ-πορεύω; to make to go before. Pass. and mid., to go before: Luk.1:76, Act.7:40" (LXX) ,†; (AS)

G4393.definition: to bring forth: with accusative of thing(s), before ἐκ, Luk.6:45.†; (AS)

G4366.definition: προσ-ρήγνυμι; to break against, dash against; (a) trans. (παιδία πέτραις, FlJ, Ant., ix, 4, 6); (b) intrans., with dative: Luk.6:48-49 (cf. προσπίπτω).†; (AS)

G4321.definition: προσ-αναλίσκω ; to spend besides: Luk.8:43 (WH, R, mg., om.).†; (AS)

G4317.definition: προσ-άγω; 1. trans., to bring or lead: with accusative and dative, Act.16:20; metaphorically, τ. θεῷ, 1Pe.3:18; before ὧδε, Luk.9:41; pass., with dative, Mat.18:24 (προσηνέχθη, T); in forensic sense, to summon: Act.12:6 (προαγαγεῖν, T, WH, mg., R). ; 2. Intrans., to draw near, approach (Jos.3:9, Jer.26:3 (Jer.46:3), al.): with dative, Act.27:27 (WH, προσαχεῖν).†; (AS)

G4325.definition: to spend besides: with accusative, Luk.10:35.†; SYN.: προσαναλίσκω (AS)

G4379.definition: προσ-ψαύω ; in poët. and late writers, ; to touch: with dative, Luk.11:46.†; (AS)

G4320.definition: προσ-ανα-βαίνω; 1. to go up besides. ; 2. to go up higher: Luk.14:10.†; (AS)

G4390.definition: προ-τρέχω; 1. to run forward. ; 2. to run on, run in advance: Jhn.20:4; before εἰς τὸ ἔμπροσθεν, Luk.19:4.†; (AS)

G4333.definition: προσ-εργάζομαι ; 1. to work or do service besides (Hdt., Plut.). ; 2. to gain besides, by working or trading: Luk.19:16 (Xen.).†; (AS)

G4304.definition: to practise beforehand : with infinitive, (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G4329.definition: (ιροσδοκάω),  ; expectation: with genitive obj., Luk.21:26; with genitive subjc., Act.12:11.†; (AS)

G4391.definition: προ-ϋπ-άρχω; 1. to be beforehand in. ; 2. to be before or previously: with ptcp., Luk.23:12, Act.8:9.†; (AS)

G4364.definition: προσ-ποιέω, -ῶ; to make over to, add or attach to. Mid., to take to oneself, claim; hence, to pretend; with inf. (cf. Xen., Anab., iv, 3, 20), to make as if: Luk.24:28.†; (AS)

G4386.definition: before; (adv.) before, formerly, an earlier time ; former, prior, Eph. 4:22; before, former, prior, Eph. 4:22; before, formerly, Jn. 6:62

G4371.definition: (φαγεῖν), ; Hellenistic for ὄψον ὀψάριον) ; a relish or dainty (esp, cooked fish), to be eaten with bread: Jhn.21:5 (have ye taken any fish, Field, Notes, 109; Abbott, Essays, 105; cf. M, Pr., 170n; MM, Exp., xxi).†; (AS)

G4362.definition: προσ-πήγνυμι ; to fasten to: absol., to crucify, Act.2:23.†; (AS)

G4308.definition: προ-οράω, -ῶ; to see before (as to place or time): with accusative, Act.21:29. Mid., with accusative, before ἐνώπιόν μου, Act.2:25 (LXX).†; (AS)

G4309.definition: προ-ορίζω ; to predetermine, foreordain: with accusative, Rom.8:30; id. and inf., Act.4:28; id. before εἰς, 1Co.2:7, Eph.1:5; with dupl. accusative, Rom.8:26; pass., Eph.1:11.†; (AS)

G4381.definition: προσωπο-λήμπτης (Rec. -λήπτης, see Bl., § 6, 8), -ου, ὁ ; (πρόσωπον λαμβάνειν, see: πρόσωπον), ; a respecter of persons: Act.10:34 (on this group of cognate forms, see Mayor, da., 78 f.; and cf. Thackeray, Gr., 44).†; (AS)

G4354.definition: προσ-λαλέω, -ῶ; to speak to: Act.28:20; with dative of person(s), Act.13:43.†; (AS)

G4311.definition: προ-πέμπω; 1. to send before, send forth. ; 2. to set forward on a journey, escort: with accusative of person(s), 1Co.16:11, Tit.3:13, 3Jn.6; before εἰς, Act.20:38; οὗ, 1Co.16:6; ἕως, Act.21:5; pass., Act.15:3, Rom.15:24, 2Co.1:16.†; (AS)

G4345.definition: προσ-κληρόω, -ῶ ; to allot to, assign to by lot; pass. (but perh. as nid., EV, consorted with, so Syr.): Act.17:4 (for exx., v, Cremer, 749).†; (AS)

G4326.definition: προσ-δέομαι; to want further, need in addition: Act.17:25.†; (AS)

G4373.definition: adv. (see: πρόσφατος),  ; recently: Act.18:2 (see MM, Exp., xxi).†; (AS)

G4389.definition: προ-τρέπω; to urge forwards, exhort, persuade. Mid., in same sense (as also in cl.): Act.18:27.†; (AS)

G4312.definition: (προπίπτω),  ; falling forwards, headlong. Metaphorical, precipitate, rash, reck­less: of persons, 2Ti.3:4; of things, Act.19:36.†; (AS)

G4376.definition: προσ-φορά, -ᾶς, ἡ; (προσφέρω),  ; 1. a bringing to, offering (Plat., al.). ; 2. (Less frequently in cl.), a present, an offering; in NT, of sacrificial offerings: Act.21:26 24:17, Eph.5:2, Heb.10:5, 8 10:14; περί ἀμαρτίας, Heb.10:18; with genitive obj., Rom.15:16, Heb.10:10.†; (AS)

G4385.definition: προ-τείνω, ; to stretch out, stretch forth: of preparations for scourging (see Field, Notes, 136 f.), Act.22:25.†; (AS)

G4307.definition: (πρόνοος, careful)  ; foresight, forethought: Act.24:3; π. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive (Dem., 546, 6), make provision for, show care for: Rom.13:14.†; (AS)

G4330.definition: to suffer to go further , τινά (New Testament) (ML)

G4388.definition: προ-τίθημι; 1. to set before, set forth publicly; so also in mid.: with accusative of person(s), Rom.3:25 (for a suggested alt, rend., see MM, xxii). ; 2. Mid., to set before oneself, propose, purpose: with inf., Rom.1:13; with accusative of thing(s), Eph.1:9.†; (AS)

G4382.definition: προσωπολημψία (Rec. -ληψία), -ας, ἡ ; (προσωπολήμπτης) ; respect of persons: Rom.2:11, Eph.6:9, Col.3:25, Jas.2:1 (see Mayor, in l).†; (AS)

G4318.definition: προσ-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ ; (προσάγω), ; 1. a bringing to. ; 2. approach, access (see Lft., Notes, 284; MM, xxi): Rom.5:2, Eph.2:18 3:12 (but see Ellic., Eph., 59 f., where the transitive sense "introduction " is advocated).†; (AS)

G4348.definition: πρόσ-κομμα, -τος, τό; (προσκόπτω),  ; (a) a stumble, stumbling: λίθος προσκόμματος (= נֶגֶף אֶבֶן, Isa, l.with), figuratively, Rom.9:32-33, 1Pe.2:8" (LXX); (b) = προσκοπή, an occasion of stumbling, a stumbling-block: metaphorically, Rom.14:13, 20, 1Co.8:9 (Plut.).†; SYN.: σκάνδαλον (cf. Cremer, 752 f.) (AS)

G4356.definition: πρόσ-λημψις (Rec. -ληψις, as in Att..), -εως, ἡ ; (προσλαμβάνω), ; 1. an assumption (Plat.). ; 2. a receiving (cf. προσλαμβάνω): Rom.11:15,†; (AS)

G4306.definition: προ-μοέω, -ῶ and depon. -έομαι, οῦμαι,; 1. to foresee. ; 2. to provide (RV, take thought for): with accusative of thing(s), καλά, Rom.12:17 (-ούμενοι), 2Co.8:21 (-οῦμεν). ; 3. to provide for (before περί, Wis, l.with): with genitive of person(s), 1Ti.5:8 (-εῖ, WH, mg., -εῖται).†; (AS)

G4368.definition: (fem, of προοτάτης), ; a patroness, protectress: Rom.16:2.†; (AS)

G4332.definition: (πρόσεδρος, sitting near),  ; 1. to sit near. ; 2. to attend regularly: with dative, 1Co.9:13, Rec. (see: παρεδρεύω).†; παρ-εδρεύω; to sit constantly beside, attend constantly (cf. MM, xix): τ. θυσιαστηρίω, 1Co.9:13.†; (AS)

G4322.definition: προσ-αναπληρόω, -ῶ; to fill up by adding to, to supply fully: 2Co.9:12 11:9.†; (AS)

G4323.definition: προσ-ανα-τίθημι ; to lay on or offer besides; mid., ; (a) to lay on oneself in addition, undertake besides; (b) with genitive of person(s), of giving or obtaining information, to consult, communicate: Gal.1:16 2:6 (Lft., in l; cf. ἀνα-τίθημι) ; (AS)

G4300.definition: προ-κυρόω, -ῶ ; to establish or confirm beforehand: Gal.3:17.†; (AS)

G4375.definition: (φιλέω),  ; (a) of persons, in both act, and pass. sense (LXX, ll. with); (b) of things, pleas­ing, agreeable (EV, lovely): Php.4:8.†; (AS)

G4338.definition: προσ-ηλόω -ῶ; to nail to: with accusative and dative, figuratively, Col.2:14.†; (AS)

G4310.definition: to suffer first or beforehand , (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: to be ill-treated before , ὑπό τινος (Thucydides):—;also, ἀγαθὸν πρ. (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G4359.definition: to owe besides or still , (Thucydides): absolute, προσοφείλοντας ἡμᾶς ἐνέγραψεν (Demosthenes Orator):—;Pass. to be still owing, be still due , (Thucydides); so, ἡ ἔχθρη ἡ προσοφειλομένη ἐς Ἀθηναίους ἐκ τῶν Αἰγινητέων the hatred which was still due from the Aeginetans to the Athenians, i. e. their ancient feud, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G4360.definition: προσ-οχθίζω; to be angry with: with dative, Heb.3:10 (LXX), Heb.3:17.†; (AS)

G4316.definition: προσ-αγορεύω; to address, greet, salute; hence, to call by name, address, style: with dupl. accusative, pass., Heb.5:10.†; (AS)
